protocol.label_rule: down: r < -0.05; neutral: -0.05 <= r <= 0.05; up: r > 0.05; tolerance handles floating-point boundary noise only
protocol.selection: maximize equal-fold macro F1; fixed three labels; tie-break by mean multiclass log-loss; keep simple baseline if gain < 0.005
protocol.regression_policy: Reuse original holdout/latest bundles verbatim; never fit or select a regression model
protocol.test_status: Exploratory comparison on previously observed historical test interval, NOT a fresh independent holdout
